property_summary: After calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount) the contract's currentBetLimit() equals exactly the provided amount.

For any nonnegative amount passed to AdjustBetAmounts, the reference sets betLimit equal to that amount when starting from zero (i.e., betLimit == amount after the call); the mutant instead accumulates and will make betLimit != amount for some amounts, so there exist inputs where the equality breaks.

For any uint256 amount passed to AdjustBetAmounts when starting from a known initial betLimit (0), the reference sets betLimit exactly to that amount after the call; the mutant that adds to betLimit instead produces a different betLimit for at least some fuzzed amounts (i.e., betLimit != amount), which the test will detect by fuzzing amount and asserting equality.

For any uint256 delta passed to AdjustBetAmounts when the initial betLimit is nonzero, the reference contract sets betLimit equal to that delta (overwriting previous value) only when initial betLimit was zero, but more generally the invariant is that performing AdjustBetAmounts with amount = 0 is a no-op on the reference (leaves betLimit unchanged) while the mutant increments betLimit by 0 (also no-op) — that was tried; instead we use two sequential calls: in the reference, calling AdjustBetAmounts(a) then AdjustBetAmounts(b) results in betLimit == b (second call overwrites) whereas the mutant results in betLimit == a + b (accumulates), so the rule is: after two consecutive AdjustBetAmounts calls, the reference's betLimit equals the second call's parameter; the mutant violates this for some fuzzed (a,b).
After calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount) as owner, the contract's currentBetLimit() equals the provided amount.

After calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount) and then wager() with msg.value equal to the bet limit, hasPlayerWagered(caller) becomes true only if the contract accepted exactly amount as the bet limit (i.e., wager requires msg.value == betLimit), so for provided amount the caller can wager when sending exactly amount but not when sending amount+1.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount), the public getter currentBetLimit() returns exactly the provided amount (no off-by-one).
After AdjustBetAmounts(amount) the contract's currentBetLimit() equals the provided amount.
Only the owner can change betLimit (AdjustBetAmounts) — calling AdjustBetAmounts by the whale must not change currentBetLimit.
